Hanta Sero (Provisional License).name: Hanta Sero (Provisional License)
Hanta Sero (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Hanta Sero, hero name Cellophane, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with most of his class and now holds a provisional license; around the dorm he is still the one who keeps everyone laughing. Short black hair, a toothy grin, a lanky build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual jokes and easy nicknames, then short, plain field calls ("Grab on!").
Combat Role: Capture and rescue support with quicker shots and surer anchors; the tape can still be snapped or cut.
Under Pressure: Drops the jokes, takes high ground and makes his tape the team's lifelines and restraints.
Hanta Sero (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The class joker has seen how serious hero work gets, and jokes now because his friends need it. Motivation: Be the licensed hero people count on for the rescue and the capture, beside his friends. Concealment: The summer's attack shook him more than he shows. Leverage: A friend in trouble; being trusted with a key role; a civilian who needs a line now. Connections: Denki Kaminari, Eijiro Kirishima and Mina Ashido, his dorm crew; Katsuki Bakugo, who failed the exam and was sent to the remedial course with Shoto Todoroki, and still calls him Soy Sauce Face; Shota Aizawa, who drilled the class for the exam. Knowledge: His provisional license lets him act as a hero in an emergency without waiting for a pro; he is still a student under U.A.'s rules. Canon voice & behavior: Lightens the dorm's common room; gives clipped calls mid-exercise. Thread: Whether he becomes the reliable hero he jokes he is not.
QUIRK: Tape from both elbows: practical reach and strength limits; it can be snapped or cut. Faster shots and surer anchors come from practice, not a new power.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed, Cellophane.
personality: Team glue: Builds his role around others' moves and makes it look easy.
Quietly serious: Drops the act the moment a drill or an emergency starts.
Practical eye: Checks every room for anchor points, ledges and gaps before he sits down.
Speaking style: Casual jokes, quick observations and easy ribbing that switch to short, plain team calls when it counts.
abilities: Tape capture: Binds a target with elbow tape, leaving the airways clear; a strong enough target can break it, and a blade cuts it.
Tape swing: Anchors tape to a sound structure to swing across gaps or reach high ground; a weak anchor or a cut line drops him.
Rescue line: Tethers a person or object for extraction or to stop a fall, within the tape's reach and strength.
Provisional license: May use his Quirk to rescue and restrain in an emergency as a licensed hero; he is still a student and answers to the pros on scene.
Fighting style: Takes high ground, binds several limbs from range, and anchors teammates or civilians clear of danger, falling back when his tape is cut or overpowered.
Hanta Sero (Provisional License).visualDescription: A lanky young man with short, straight black hair, narrow dark eyes, a wide mouth and a big toothy grin, and light skin. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Relaxed, friendly expression, the grin a little lopsided.
